name: MUTra-CDMX
description: The growing complexity of urban mobility requires datasets that integrate dynamic traffic observations with meteorological, geometric, and urban-context information. This study presents MUTra-CDMX, a multisource urban traffic dataset covering a 14.72 km section of the Insurgentes Sur corridor in Mexico City. Traffic data were obtained from TomTom at five-minute intervals for 20 consecutive road segments from 1 November 2024 to 28 February 2025.
